_about: Official places a citizen can lodge a complaint, by complaint type. Used by the Report a problem page (report/). None of these offer a public API for lodging complaints on someone's behalf, so the site hands the citizen over with pre-filled text, links and numbers. Re-check every entry before relying on it: numbers and portals change.

gba_sahaaya.name: Sahaaya app (Greater Bengaluru Authority)
gba_sahaaya.for: Garbage, roads, footpaths, drains, flooding, streetlights in public spaces, sanitation
gba_sahaaya.how: Install the Sahaaya app, sign in with your phone number, choose the complaint type and paste the text below. You get a complaint number to track.
gba_sahaaya.source: Deccan Herald, Sept 2026: officials direct citizens to raise complaints in the Sahaaya app; Sahaaya 3.0 upgrade in progress.

bescom_helpline.name: BESCOM 24x7 helpline
bescom_helpline.for: Power cuts, transformer faults, electricity safety
bescom_helpline.how: Call 1912 or send the text below on WhatsApp. Ask for a complaint number.
bescom_helpline.source: BESCOM Contact Us page lists 1912 and WhatsApp 9449844640; some third-party sites list other WhatsApp numbers, so confirm on the BESCOM site.

bwssb_helpline.name: BWSSB 24x7 helpline
bwssb_helpline.for: No water, low pressure, sewage overflow, open manholes
bwssb_helpline.how: Call 1916 and give the location below. Ask for a complaint number.
bwssb_helpline.source: Listed as BWSSB's 24x7 helpline by multiple sources, including Karnataka iPGRS listings.

traffic_station.name: Your local traffic police station
traffic_station.for: Signals not working, congestion, illegal parking
traffic_station.how: Contact the traffic police station for this ward, shown in the contacts above.
traffic_station.source: Station and officer contacts come from the ward data (data/officials/wards.json).

emergency.name: Emergency: 112
emergency.for: Anything dangerous right now: live wires, open manholes, flooding with people at risk
emergency.how: Call 112 first if someone could be hurt.
